snippet.title: 1-2-Whopping Word Search! - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
1-2-Whopping Word Search is sequel to "1-2-Word Search!" packed with all new features! This game now utilizes multiple grid sizes for both large and small puzzles. Each level now has a hidden word to find that will unlock new music, and there are more than 10 new background themes that completely change the look and feel of the game. 1-2-Whopping Word Search! is classic word search puzzle game with a TreeFall twist! Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches while listening to the TreeFall Radio!

Developed by TreeFall Studios
Also released on PlayStation 5
